logic.bm: Power Systems segment (target): power transformers and auto-transformers up to 765 kV (e.g. 500 MVA 765 kV single-phase auto-transformer), 400/765 kV shunt reactors, distribution transformers (engineering up to 220 kV class), switchgear (EHV/MV circuit breakers, 145 kV GIS, 33 kV VCB panels, instrument transformers, vacuum interrupters, bushings) and T&D projects (Gurgaon engineering-projects division). Industrial Systems (motors, drives, railway traction/signalling) and, from FY2026, Semiconductors (CG Semi OSAT) are separate segments. Source: FY2025-26 Annual Report product pages & 'Establishments' list (pp.8-9, 384-385).
logic.recognition: 제품 출하·고객 검수 또는 프로젝트 진행률의 회사 공시 기준을 대사. 수주액·수주잔고·수출통계는 매출과 별도.
logic.bridge: 이미 인식한 누적 매출 + 납기별 기초 수주잔고 전환 + 당기 수주 중 인도 가능한 물량. 생산능력·취소·검수·환율을 별도 가정.

structural_breaks.note: Consumer Products business demerged into Crompton Greaves Consumer Electricals (scheme approved by Bombay HC Nov-2015; record date fixed Feb-2016). Comparatives in FY2016Q3+ filings exclude it.

Ind AS adopted from FY2017 (Q1 FY2017 filing restates FY2016 comparatives); overseas power subsidiaries progressively classified as held for sale/discontinued under Ind AS 105 (Canada power business sold during FY2016)

'Belgium Group' (CG Power Systems Belgium NV and three downstream subsidiaries, Power Systems segment) deconsolidated from 1-Jan-2020 after loss of access/insolvency — consolidated Power Systems revenue falls from INR 7,875 mn (Q3 FY20) to 1,819 mn (Q4 FY20)

FY2019 accounts restated after the 2019 forensic findings; FY2020 filings print restated FY2019 comparatives (e.g. Q3 FY2019 consolidated Power Systems 1,179.63 cr in the Dec-2019 filing vs 827.68 cr originally); the 2019-08-31 audited FY2019 filing already re-presents FY2018 comparatives on the restated basis (Q4 FY2018 Power Systems 1,522.80 cr vs 1,054.33 cr originally; consolidated revenue 2,274.82 vs 1,792.35 cr). Points FY2018Q4-FY2019Q3 are on the original basis; FY2019Q4-FY2020Q3 carry prior_year_comparative from their own filings so YoY stays same-basis [verify 2026-09-25]
Tube Investments of India (Murugappa group) acquires control via preferential allotment; no change of segment definitions

Sale of QEI (USA) business; FY2023Q4+ filings restate consolidated Power Systems comparatives ex-QEI (e.g. Q4 FY2022 469.93 -> 447.91 cr); FY2024Q2 filing re-presents Q2 FY2023 ex-QEI (Power Systems 494.16 cr, revenue 1,674.56 cr) -> stored as FY2024Q2 prior_year_comparative [verify 2026-09-25]
